about: Balance pass, step 1 (rules 1.15): the enemy table fitted with the fight simulator, 11 Nov 2026. Read with balance-sim-step1.md. Made by packages/engine/test/balance/fit.ts (BALANCE_FIT_OUT). levels: 1, 3, 6, 9, 12, 20. In every summary list the six entries are those levels in order; "open"/"cover" are the two maps; rounds are rounds to win; *_any is the percent of fights with someone Downed; *_downs is characters Downed a fight; plain_gun_* and tank_* are rounds lasted under fire (soldiers = 2 soldiers, mixed = 1 elite and 1 soldier) and *_by3 the percent of fights Down by the end of round 3; up3/up2 are percent of standard fights won against enemies 3 and 2 levels above; down5 is the most hits any enemy 5 levels below took; htk is the yardstick's hits to kill, hit its chance to hit.

round4_gap_2_a_level.changed: round 1 + levels.gap.to_hit_per_level 2 (a what-if outside the table; not built)

refit_level_6_n60.note: the same as the fitted run, after the review's fixes

fixed: a level that is not a number is no level
a level given outright ignores the shift
pinned numbers are a test tool only
a campaign file's level is read
the spawn tool's empty level is the squad's level now
a twin stands at its owner's level
the one-hit rule is on the card and in the log, after every reduction
the critical has a floor of 1.5
